no_jest_globals_import.feedback: Add explicit instruction: 'Do not import describe, it, expect, or other Jest globals from @jest/globals. clear_all_mocks_warning.quote: Write or update tests as needed
clear_all_mocks_warning.reason: The template contains no mention of jest.clearAllMocks() behavior, mockReturnValue, or the need to reset mock values in beforeEach blocks. An agent writing tests would not know that clearAllMocks() resets mock implementation but that return values must be explicitly re-set, leading to test isolation bugs.
clear_all_mocks_warning.feedback: Add guidance: 'When using jest.clearAllMocks() in afterEach or beforeEach, note that it resets the mock implementation but does not reset mockReturnValue. If you set mockReturnValue in a beforeEach, you must also explicitly re-set return values after clearAllMocks() or consolidate setup to avoid test pollution.'

eslint_catch_pattern.reason: The template does not mention error handling patterns for catch blocks at all. There is no instruction on whether to use `catch {}` or `catch (_err) {}`. An agent would follow default patterns which may violate the project's ESLint rules requiring named-parameter catch blocks to use empty braces only when the error is unused.
eslint_catch_pattern.feedback: Add explicit ESLint instruction: 'When writing tests that handle promise rejections or exceptions, use `catch {}` (without a parameter) if the error is not used, per ESLint's no-unused-vars rule. Do not use `catch (_err) {}` as this suggests intent to use a parameter that is then ignored.'
